meta.title: Charles-Erick BG — Co-founder of Viesigners | UX/UI and CRO expert
meta.description: Charles-Erick BG, co-founder of Viesigners: hybrid UX/UI and conversion rate optimization expert with 30+ combined years of experience with his brother.

sections.lead: Hybrid expert in digital user experience (UX/UI) and conversion rate optimization (CRO), co-founder of Viesigners with his brother Jean-François.

brief.t: UX/UI, CRO, designing offers and digital experiences.
Québec, Canada — French- and English-speaking markets.

sections.text: Helping companies of all sizes *perform online*, with more than 30 combined years alongside his brother.
prose: With Jean-François, Charles-Erick forms “The BG Twins”: a duo that unites customer experience and web business strategy, working as business advisor, strategic consultant and delivery partner.

items.v: [Professional website creation](@sites-web): structure, design, copy and development.
Offer design, launch strategy and market validation for service entrepreneurs.

sections.p: One first conversation is enough to know whether we can help.

a: Charles-Erick BG is co-founder of Viesigners, a Canadian web micro-agency. He is a hybrid expert in UX/UI and conversion rate optimization, with more than 30 years of combined experience with his brother Jean-François.

faq.q: What does Charles-Erick do for clients?
a: He helps companies improve their landing pages and sales journeys, clarify their offers and simplify the experience of their apps and services.
Through the [contact page](@contact) or by phone at +1 581-502-1115.
